title: Bound original exact-head BRAIN provider flight search to the immutable PR creation date, preserving full relevant history
owner: original ONE BRAIN / obligation-terminal-closure workflow, under #4198
root_cause: Post-merge original terminal closure for PR #5673 failed at GitHub Actions provider flight history read: gh api --paginate --slurp fetched all historical workflow_dispatch runs from main and GitHub returned HTTP 504 at 2026-11-12T17:15:20Z. The original workflow correctly failed closed and did not dispatch or claim terminal ACK.
evidence: Original GitHub Actions run 43267333230 job 131354324587 error BRAIN_FLIGHT_PROVIDER_READ_UNVERIFIED, HTTP 504
Original workflow .github/workflows/obligation-terminal-closure.yml full-history provider search and exact candidate title
GitHub REST documentation https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflow-runs confirms created date-time filter, pagination and maximum 1000 results for filtered searches
Original PR #5673 actual created_at 2026-11-12T17:07:05Z; a valid PR-number-specific original BRAIN verification cannot predate it
Original BRAIN flight index already checks total_count, all pages and duplicate IDs; new guard adds UTC since and search cap
impact: A GitHub provider read timeout stops the terminal handoff verifier even though protected code may be merged; prevents independent completion evidence, never a safe reason to mark an obligation green.
fix: Scope the existing original GH workflow-run source read to created >= provider PR-created-at minus 10 minutes, still paginate and total-check ALL matching runs twice and reject any 1000 cap, missing pages, duplicate run identity, out-of-period source, invalid PR date or HTTP failures. Use no other executor.
prevention_rule: Every original terminal-flight lookup is bound to independently obtained immutable PR creation time but MUST prove full pagination within that bounded provider scope before claiming absence; exact PR/head title and protected-main identity remain mandatory; provider 5xx remains red.
outcome: Protected source correction candidate only; no provider closure result, social measurement, client effect or revenue verified.
